verses.text_uthmani: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ
verses.transliteration: Iqtarabatis Saa'atu wsan shaqqal qamar

translations.text: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two].

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةًۭ يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌۭ مُّسْتَمِرٌّۭ
verses.transliteration: Wa iny yaraw aayatany yu'ridoo wa yaqooloo sihrum mustamirr

translations.text: And if they see a miracle, they turn away and say, "Passing magic."

verses.text_uthmani: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍۢ مُّسْتَقِرٌّۭ
verses.transliteration: Wa kazzaboo wattaba'ooo ahwaaa'ahum; wa kullu amrim mustaqirr

translations.text: And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a [time of] settlement.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ
verses.transliteration: Wa laqad jaaa'ahum minal ambaaa'i maa feehi muzdajar

translations.text: And there has already come to them of information that in which there is deterrence -

verses.text_uthmani: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَٰلِغَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
verses.transliteration: Hikmatum baalighatun famaa tughnin nuzur

translations.text: Extensive wisdom - but warning does not avail [them].

verses.text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍۢ نُّكُرٍ
verses.transliteration: Fatawalla 'anhum; yawma yad'ud daa'i ilaa shai 'in nukur

translations.text: So leave them, [O Muhammad]. The Day the Caller calls to something forbidding,

verses.text_uthmani: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌۭ مُّنتَشِرٌۭ
verses.transliteration: khushsha'an absaaruhum yakrujoona minal ajdaasi ka annahum jaraadum muntashir

translations.text: Their eyes humbled, they will emerge from the graves as if they were locusts spreading,

verses.text_uthmani: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Muhti'eena ilad daa'i yaqoolul kafiroona haazaa yawmun 'asir

translations.text: Racing ahead toward the Caller. The disbelievers will say, "This is a difficult Day."

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌۭ وَٱزْدُجِرَ
verses.transliteration: Kazzabat qablahum qawmu Noohin fakazzaboo 'abdanaa wa qaaloo majnoo nunw wazdujir

translations.text: The people of Noah denied before them, and they denied Our servant and said, "A madman," and he was repelled.

verses.text_uthmani: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌۭ فَٱنتَصِرْ
verses.transliteration: Fada'aa Rabbahooo annee maghloobun fantasir

translations.text: So he invoked his Lord, "Indeed, I am overpowered, so help."

verses.text_uthmani: فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍۢ مُّنْهَمِرٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Fafatahnaaa abwaabas sa maaa'i bimaa'im munhamir

translations.text: Then We opened the gates of the heaven with rain pouring down

verses.text_uthmani: وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًۭا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍۢ قَدْ قُدِرَ
verses.transliteration: Wa fajjamal arda 'uyoonan faltaqal maaa'u 'alaaa amrin qad qudir

translations.text: And caused the earth to burst with springs, and the waters met for a matter already predestined.

verses.text_uthmani: وَحَمَلْنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍۢ وَدُسُرٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Wa hamalnaahu 'alaa zaati alwaahinw wa dusur

translations.text: And We carried him on a [construction of] planks and nails,

verses.text_uthmani: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءًۭ لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
verses.transliteration: Tajree bi a'yuninaa jazaaa 'al liman kaana kufir

translations.text: Sailing under Our observation as reward for he who had been denied.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَٰهَآ ءَايَةًۭ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Wa laqat taraknaahaad aayatan fahal mim muddakir

translations.text: And We left it as a sign, so is there any who will remember?

verses.text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.transliteration: Fakaifa kaana 'azaabee wa nuzur

translations.text: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Wa laqad yassamal Quraana liz zikri fahal mimmuddakir

translations.text: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

verses.text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌۭ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.transliteration: Kazzabat 'Aadun fakaifa kaana 'azaabee wa nuzur

translations.text: 'Aad denied; and how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًۭا صَرْصَرًۭا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍۢ مُّسْتَمِرٍّۢ
verses.transliteration: Innaa arsalnaa 'alaihim reehan sarsaran fee Yawmi nahsim mustamirr

translations.text: Indeed, We sent upon them a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune,

verses.text_uthmani: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍۢ مُّنقَعِرٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Tanzi;un naasa ka anna huma'jaazu nakhlim munqa'ir

translations.text: Extracting the people as if they were trunks of palm trees uprooted.

verses.text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.transliteration: 'Fakaifa kaana 'azaabee wa nuzur

translations.text: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Wa laqad yassamal Quraana liz zikri fahal mim muddakir

translations.text: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

verses.text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verses.transliteration: Kazzabat Samoodu binnuzur

translations.text: Thamud denied the warning

verses.text_uthmani: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًۭا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًۭا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًۭا لَّفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ وَسُعُرٍ
verses.transliteration: Faqaalooo a-basharam minnaa waahidan nattabi'uhooo innaa izal lafee dalaalinw wa su'ur

translations.text: And said, "Is it one human being among us that we should follow? Indeed, we would then be in error and madness.

verses.text_uthmani: أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌۭ
verses.transliteration: 'A-ulqiyaz zikru 'alaihi mim baininaa bal huwa kazzaabun ashir

translations.text: Has the message been sent down upon him from among us? Rather, he is an insolent liar."

verses.text_uthmani: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًۭا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ
verses.transliteration: Sa-ya'lamoona ghadam manil kazzaabul ashir

translations.text: They will know tomorrow who is the insolent liar.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةًۭ لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ
verses.transliteration: Innaa mursilun naaqati fitnatal lahum fartaqibhum wastabir

translations.text: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient.

verses.text_uthmani: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍۢ مُّحْتَضَرٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Wa nabbi'hum annal maaa'a qismatum bainahum kullu shirbim muhtadar

translations.text: And inform them that the water is shared between them, each [day of] drink attended [by turn].

verses.text_uthmani: فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
verses.transliteration: Fanaadaw saahibahum fata'aataa fa'aqar

translations.text: But they called their companion, and he dared and hamstrung [her].

verses.text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.transliteration: Fakaifa kaana 'azaabee wa nuzur

translations.text: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
verses.transliteration: Innaaa arsalnaa 'alaihim saihatanw waahidatan fakaano kahasheemil muhtazir

translations.text: Indeed, We sent upon them one blast from the sky, and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Wa laqad yassarnal quraana liz zikri fahal mim muddakir

translations.text: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

verses.text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verses.transliteration: Kazzabat qawmu lootim binnuzur

translations.text: The people of Lot denied the warning.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ نَّجَّيْنَٰهُم بِسَحَرٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Innaa arsalnaa 'alaihim haasiban illaaa aala Loot najjainaahum bisahar

translations.text: Indeed, We sent upon them a storm of stones, except the family of Lot - We saved them before dawn

verses.text_uthmani: نِّعْمَةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ
verses.transliteration: Ni'matam min 'indinaa; kazaalika najzee man shakar

translations.text: As favor from us. Thus do We reward he who is grateful.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verses.transliteration: Wa laqad anzarahum batshatanaa fatamaaraw binnuzur

translations.text: And he had already warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warning.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.transliteration: Wa laqad raawadoohu 'andaifee fatamasnaaa a'yunahum fazooqoo 'azaabee wa nuzur

translations.text: And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, [saying], "Taste My punishment and warning."

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌۭ مُّسْتَقِرٌّۭ
verses.transliteration: Wa laqad sabbahahum bukratan 'azaabum mustaqirr

translations.text: And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment.

verses.text_uthmani: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.transliteration: Fazooqoo 'azaabee wa nuzur

translations.text: So taste My punishment and warning.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Wa laqad yassarnal Quraana liz zikri fahal mim muddakir

translations.text: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
verses.transliteration: Wa laqad jaaa'a Aala Fir'awnan nuzur

translations.text: And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning.

verses.text_uthmani: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرٍ
verses.transliteration: Kazzaboo bi Aayaatinaa kullihaa fa akhaznaahum akhza 'azeezim muqtadir

translations.text: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability.

verses.text_uthmani: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌۭ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
verses.transliteration: Akuffaarukum khairum min ulaaa'ikum am lakum baraaa'atun fiz Zubur

translations.text: Are your disbelievers better than those [former ones], or have you immunity in the scripture?

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌۭ مُّنتَصِرٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Am yaqooloona nahnu jamee'um muntasir

translations.text: Or do they say, "We are an assembly supporting [each other]"?

verses.text_uthmani: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
verses.transliteration: Sa yuhzamul jam'u wa yuwalloonad dubur

translations.text: [Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat].

verses.text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
verses.transliteration: Balis Saa'atu maw'iduhum was Saa'atu adhaa wa amarr

translations.text: But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ وَسُعُرٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Innal mujrimeena fee dalaalinw wa su'ur

translations.text: Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness.

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
verses.transliteration: Yawma yushaboona fin Naari'alaa wujoohimim zooqoo massa saqar

translations.text: The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces [it will be said], "Taste the touch of Saqar."

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَٰهُ بِقَدَرٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Innaa kulla shai'in khalaqnaahu biqadar

translations.text: Indeed, all things We created with predestination.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌۭ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ
verses.transliteration: Wa maaa amrunaaa illaa waahidatun kalamhim bilbasar

translations.text: And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Wa laqad ahlaknaaa ashyaa'akum fahal mim muddakir

translations.text: And We have already destroyed your kinds, so is there any who will remember?

verses.text_uthmani: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍۢ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
verses.transliteration: Wa kullu shai'in fa'aloohu fiz Zubur

translations.text: And everything they did is in written records.

verses.text_uthmani: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍۢ وَكَبِيرٍۢ مُّسْتَطَرٌ
verses.transliteration: Wa kullu sagheerinw wa kabeerim mustatar

translations.text: And every small and great [thing] is inscribed.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَنَهَرٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Innal muttaqeena fee jannaatinw wa nahar

translations.text: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers,

verses.text_uthmani: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ
verses.transliteration: Fee maq'adi sidqin 'inda Maleekim Muqtadir

translations.text: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability.
